summary: Pan American Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release announcing that director Charles (Chuck) Jeannes will retire from the Board of Directors effective October 31, 2026. Jeannes joined the board following the 2019 Tahoe Resources acquisition and is departing to focus on his role as Chair of Equinox Gold Corp., assumed July 31, 2026. Board Chair Gillian Winckler and CEO Michael Steinmann provided statements. No terms, advisors, or special-situation mechanics are disclosed; this is a routine, planned director retirement, not a forced or abrupt management change event.
